items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: He used to call him Brown, uh, Frey. He was playing Frey.

ctx.x: I've heard of it. I don't remember who was in it, but who else was in it?
Yeah, there was a boy walking around here. No, he's blind. He'd been blind every time. He used to call him Brown, uh, Frey. He was playing Frey.
Yeah, he used to play harmonica and then clarinet.
